submitted.rationale: With only 3 merit measurements, I tested compositions based on priors about BiVO4 and copper vanadate. The composition most like BiVO4 (idx 3, Bi0.40Cu0.19V0.41) gave only 3.1e-7 A. Idx 8 (Bi0.18Cu0.34V0.48) gave 1.29e-6 A. That composition is near a BiVO4 plus copper vanadate mixture; copper vanadate absorbs more at 2.4 eV. Moving further toward the Cu/V side (idx 95, Bi0.14Cu0.40V0.46) gave 1.18e-6 A, slightly lower. So the peak appears to lie near idx 8.

rejected.reason: Measured 3.1e-7 A. The Bi-rich, BiVO4-like region is about 4x lower than idx 8.
Measured 1.18e-6 A, slightly below idx 8. Adding more Cu past idx 8 did not help.
